citizen_question: I am 45 and I sell vegetables from a cart in Sundarpur Old City. Our family income is about ₹1,80,000 a year. Can I get the free accident insurance?
resolution: Yes, you can enrol in Suraksha Bima Yojana. Street vendors aged 18 to 59 with an annual household income of ₹2,50,000 or less are eligible. Bring an age proof, your vendor or labour card (or a letter from the ward office or Gram Panchayat) and your bank passbook to the service centre. Enrolment is open until 2026-11-20 (20 November 2026). The cover is ₹2,00,000 and the state pays the premium.
